title: project.activate mints its own measured witness and refuses a caller-supplied one
description:
SPIDR child B of task-bb844c288fb346c0856778c738b9f073. dependsOn child A (task-741dad13e23d441a8385d0f14df5b5c1) for the receipts module. Filed by architect-d1711c47 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the daemon stops trusting the caller for the activation witness and mints it from child A's measured receipts. This is the row that closes the actual product gap - today ANY caller can hand over invented refs and the daemon commits them.

MEASURED AT 68eb1c5d:
- apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-services.ts:108-120 `activateProject` reads `payload.witness`, refuses BOOTSTRAP_PAYLOAD_INVALID @ DAEMON_INGRESS when absent, and otherwise passes the CALLER'S OBJECT STRAIGHT INTO the core reducer. Nothing measures anything.
- TWO fakers exist today, not one. (1) apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/demo-seed-payloads.ts:127-137 (the seed). (2) apps/control-room/src/live/live-dispatch-payloads.ts:111-119 `DEV_PAYLOADS`, whose witness is artifact-1/backup-1/hex64("cafe") and which tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts clicks end-to-end from an EMPTY store. So "the browser cannot drive the chain" is only true of the v2 UI; the legacy dev board drives it with fake refs.
- apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts:314 declares `"project.activate": ["witness"]` as the payload key roster - changing what the payload may carry is a roster edit here, and the roster has asserting tests.
- apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-sequence.ts:31 and :107 hold project.activate's prerequisite chain (register + bind_repository + provider.probe).
- packages/core/src/project/project-validation.ts:158 validActivation demands the EXACT 9 keys, real 64-hex for the two hashes, and truthClass in {DAEMON_VERIFIED, HUMAN_APPROVED}.

DESIGN (settled at plan time, do not re-derive): the browser sends `project.activate` and the DAEMON measures. A witness that crosses the wire could be altered by a hostile caller, so a caller-supplied `witness` is REFUSED with its own stable code rather than ignored - silently dropping it would let an operator believe they supplied authority they did not. When every member measures, the handler mints the 9-key witness with truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED and commits. When ANY member is unmeasurable, the WHOLE activation refuses with that member's code from child A - fail closed, no partial witness, nothing committed.

KEEP WORKING (parent DoD 4): `pnpm seed` must still pass. The seed sends its own witness, so this change WILL break it unless the seed is updated in the same commit - update demo-seed-payloads.ts/demo-seed-plan.ts to stop sending one, and keep the chain ORDER in demo-seed-plan.ts:190-196 unchanged. The same applies to DEV_PAYLOADS in live-dispatch-payloads.ts and to board-chain.spec.ts's expectations.

NOT IN SCOPE: the receipts read route and the UI card (child C); the e2e journey, copy and docs (child D).
definitionOfDone: `activateProject` in apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-services.ts mints the witness from child A's measured receipts; a test asserts the committed event payload carries the MEASURED repo toplevel + HEAD sha, provider CLI version, store path/driver and backup sha256 - asserting the actual values, not merely that 9 keys are present.

A caller-supplied `witness` is refused with a stable code AND layer (e.g. ACTIVATION_WITNESS_CALLER_SUPPLIED @ DAEMON_INGRESS); a test asserts that exact code and layer, and asserts NOTHING was committed to the store on that path.

When any single member is unmeasurable the WHOLE activation refuses with that member's code from child A; one test per member asserts code + layer + no commit, and confirms no partial witness is written. Each arm verified red by mutating the production surface (global rail 1).
The minted witness passes packages/core validActivation unchanged - core is NOT edited by this row; a test drives the real reducer with the minted witness and asserts it is accepted.

daemon-command-vocabulary.ts payload-key roster and any asserting roster test are updated together, with bidirectional set-equality (global rail 9); `grep -n '"project.activate"' apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts` reflects the new payload contract.

`pnpm seed` keeps working: apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/demo-seed-*.test.ts green with the count line quoted, and the seed chain ORDER at demo-seed-plan.ts:190-196 (project.register -> project.bind_repository -> provider.probe -> project.activate -> 3x policy.install) is unchanged - proven by grep, not by reading.
Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (root lane). An exit-0 leg with no `Test Files N passed` line is a vacuous run (global rail 8).
taskRails: FAIL CLOSED: no partial witness, no defaulted member, no 'measure what we can'. One unmeasurable member refuses the whole activation with that member's code.
DO NOT EDIT packages/core. The minted witness must satisfy the EXISTING validActivation; if it cannot, stop and report rather than widening core's roster.

Both fakers move together or the tree goes red: the seed (demo-seed-payloads.ts) and DEV_PAYLOADS (apps/control-room/src/live/live-dispatch-payloads.ts, asserted by tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts). Name all of them in affectedFiles at plan time - discovering one at step 5 is the plan-time grep this rail exists to force.
